binding.system:
你是 A-only 规范事实库和信息覆盖审核员。输入都是另一轮审核已经确认 E1/E2 的完整原子命题；它们可能有重复、宽泛形式及互补细节。只看 A 发言及这些命题，不能看算法名称、旧金标准来源，也不能引用 B 发言。输出 JSON。
目标：将关于同一 B 实体、同一事件、同一关系的命题合并为一个最有信息量且 A 侧确实支持的规范事实；把不同关系（例如姓名/职业/拥有物）分开。同一事件的时间、对象、程度、状态放进 slots，不要产生新的无证据字段。事件不同不能因同属一类而合并。语义上部分覆盖但未完整恢复的命题可以加入同一 fact，只标记它确实覆盖的字段。严格不能因为宽泛预测便给它未提到的具体 slot。
每个 fact 要有 canonical_claim、level(E1|E2)、slots(至少一个 core/required)，members(引用所有被分配的 atom_id，且声明每条 atom 覆盖哪些 slot_ids)。core=true 表示主体-谓词-关键对象的核心判断；required=true 表示完整恢复金标准/事实需覆盖的字段。每个 slot.weight 取1或2，核心可设2，其他1。所有输入 atom 必须恰好分配一次；不得发明 atom_id；不准把原本 E2 细节提升为 E1。若同一 fact 同时含 E1/E2 证据，level 按整个最完整命题的支持机制选择。
只输出 {"facts":[{"id":"f1","canonical_claim":"B ...","level":"E1|E2","slots":[{"id":"s1","name":"role|relation|object|time|state|...","value":"...","core":true,"required":true,"weight":2}],"members":[{"atom_id":"...","slot_ids":["s1"]}]}]}。只对输入命题中实际陈述的字段建立覆盖，禁止把另一个输入成员的细节自动分配给本成员。

visible_turns.text: Did you hear that they are going to start an exercise class after work ?
Next month . I think . Are you going to sign up ?

atoms.claim: B is a potential participant in an exercise class planned to start next month
B works or has a regular work schedule
B asked when the exercise class would start
B has employment or a regular work schedule
B shares a workplace or social circle with A
B is in a position to hear about workplace announcements
B is in the same workplace or community as A
B is employed or has a work schedule
The exercise class has a registration process that B could participate in

facts.canonical_claim: B is employed or has a regular work schedule

slots.name: state
slots.value: employed / has a regular work schedule

facts.canonical_claim: B shares a workplace or community with A

slots.name: relation
slots.value: same workplace or community as A

facts.canonical_claim: B is in a position to hear about workplace announcements

slots.name: state
slots.value: in a position to hear workplace announcements

facts.canonical_claim: B is a potential participant in an exercise class planned to start next month, which has a registration process B could join

slots.name: role
slots.value: potential participant in the exercise class

slots.name: object
slots.value: registration process available for B to sign up

facts.canonical_claim: B asked when the exercise class would start

slots.name: relation
slots.value: B asked about the start time of the exercise class
